guardian.utility: A thick glowing GOLD RING viewed obliquely, encircling one steel shield; three broad white force arrows deflect off the ring. One shield, no people, no dome. The ring is the identifying silhouette.
aegis.signature: Two distinctly sized silver-and-gold shields linked diagonally by one thick luminous chain. The large foreground shield intercepts a red arrow aimed at the smaller shield. No people. Emphasize the LINK between them.
aegis.utility: Three tall upright translucent gold barrier plates forming a fortified WALL, seen at a three-quarter angle, stopping a dark arrow with a white impact flare. Strong rectangular stepped silhouette, no people, no domes, no circular ring.
bulwark.signature: One enormous tower shield planted firmly into cracked stone, anchored by two thick chains. Broad square shield and deeply planted base, immovable defense, no people.
bulwark.utility: A broad gold-lit stone platform beneath one shield, with broken purple chains flying off its edges. Emphasize safe consecrated ground and freedom from control.
shieldbearer.signature: One large central golden shield connected by two branching ivory tethers to two smaller ally shields, a clear Y-shaped composition. No people, no chain.
shieldbearer.utility: A silver shield flanked by two swept golden wings and a short green-gold forward motion streak. Protective advancing wall, not an angel or full figure.
justicar.signature: A massive gold-headed mace storing red sparks inside its head, held back ready to swing, one crescent of captured red force. Close view, no figure.
justicar.utility: A dark attacking fist restrained beneath a heavy golden seal, its red glow fading to dull grey. Dominant clenched fist and constraining gold band.
templar.signature: A blazing gold mace striking downward, splitting into one red damaging arc and one ivory healing arc. No figures, bold branching impact.
templar.utility: One large polished gold handbell ringing out two broad ivory cleansing arcs that break purple wisps. Bell fills square, no figures.
inquisitor.signature: A heavy silver execution blade descending diagonally toward a cracked crimson elite crest. Clear blade silhouette, golden edge, no gore or figure.
inquisitor.utility: A piercing ivory-gold eye shining through a cracked dark mask, its gaze marked by one angular golden reticle. No figures.
warlord.signature: A gold-rimmed war horn sounding a broad outward shockwave, small shield-shaped glints caught in the wave. One horn, no people.
warlord.utility: An armored fist raised through shattered icy blue shackles, with upward golden speed streaks. Close view, no face.
marshal.signature: A short planted golden battle banner on a thick spear, upright and stable, a luminous circle glowing at its stone base. Crimson cloth, no people.
marshal.utility: Three small gold shields moving into a tight straight row beneath one sweeping guiding arrow. Broad simple shield silhouettes, no figures.
bannerlord.signature: A richly gold-fringed crimson standard sweeping forward diagonally, wrapped in one strong luminous aura. Large billowing cloth and spearhead, no figure.
bannerlord.utility: One armored golden boot striding forward through a pair of sweeping upward speed chevrons. Bright amber trail, no figure.
strategist.signature: Three steel shields locked in a precise triangular formation, connected by crisp golden lines, one spear rises at the center. Overhead emblem composition.
strategist.utility: A steel shield leading a large curling gold arrow backward to safety, blue impact on outward side. No people. Retreat indicated by curved arrow.
conqueror.signature: A roaring golden lion muzzle pulling dark force wisps inward with two thick curled arcs. Strong open-mouth silhouette, no humanoid.
conqueror.utility: A gold armored fist driving forward with an orange motion trail and one swordlike flare. Horizontal thrust, no full figure.
tyrant.signature: A heavy jagged golden crown pressing down over a bowed dark helmet, crimson pressure arcs. Dominant crown and bowed head silhouette.
tyrant.utility: A dark boot locked inside a luminous golden bear trap, thick tightening magical chains. Close view, no injury or gore.
champion.signature: A broad silver sword sweeping a bright gold crescent across a dark backdrop. A second shorter red echo on the blade's path indicates extended aggression. No people.
champion.utility: Two crossed silver dueling blades above a powerful outward golden shove arc. Symmetrical weapon emblem, no people.
bloodrager.signature: A jagged iron axe head surging forward, a cracked crimson heart behind it feeding bright red energy into the edge. Bold axe and heart emblem, no figure.
bloodrager.utility: A roaring red wolf muzzle shattering an icy blue collar, orange fury sparks gathering below its jaw. Close head silhouette.
reaver.signature: A curved iron axe drawing a thick crimson ribbon from its blade into one glowing red heart. Symbolic life steal, no bodies or gore.
reaver.utility: A wolf's large keen nose and amber eye catching a bright red scent trail leading toward a distant small heart symbol. Close profile, dark background.
bloodstorm.signature: Two broad iron axe blades whirling in a circular crimson cyclone, a small bright red heart at its calm center. Strong circular spiral silhouette.
bloodstorm.utility: A single heavy boot planted inside a luminous crimson pool, three broad red healing wisps rising from the pool. Symbolic red magic, no gore.
deathless.signature: A skull-shaped dark death blade stopped by a brilliant crimson heart encased in iron bands. Single heart wins the collision, dramatic white flash, no gore.
deathless.utility: A roaring iron helmet with a glowing red heart-shaped core at the throat, broad silver shield-shaped sound arc. No full figure.
slayer.signature: An execution axe with three stepped orange impact echoes sweeping toward a cracked red target crest. Strong rhythmic repeated edge, no bodies.
slayer.utility: A single iron hunting boot rushing toward a bright red reticle, amber speed streaks stretched behind. Diagonal chase motif.
headsman.signature: A huge squared execution axe dropping vertically through a shattered crimson target crest. Black iron, bright white edge, no gore or figures.
headsman.utility: One dark target helmet trapped inside a sharp crimson diamond mark, the mark tapering downward like an execution blade. Close emblem.
harvester.signature: Three iron sickle blades linked by a sweeping red energy ribbon leading into a glowing heart. Curved chain composition, no victims.
harvester.utility: One enormous hooked iron sickle pulling two small dim crimson heart crests inward on a thick red ribbon. No people.
juggernaut.signature: A giant iron fist breaking the ground upward in two huge orange stone plates. Dominant fist and rising rubble, no figure.
juggernaut.utility: A massive dark iron boot breaking through icy shackles with a bright orange forward streak. Unstoppable heavy movement, no figure.
crusher.signature: A spiked iron mace striking cracked stone with a broad orange shock ring and two lifted boulders. Close impact motif.
crusher.utility: A jagged orange fissure racing forward between two dark stone slabs that tip violently upward. Ground split fills square, no weapon or figure.
siegebreaker.signature: A heavy iron warhammer smashing a broad masonry shield into a few large chunks. Orange impact, bold hammer silhouette.
siegebreaker.utility: A dark fortress shield split wide down the center with a bright red gap and one orange arrow passing through. Defense breach emblem.
titanbane.signature: A relatively small bright iron axe stopping a gigantic dark stone fist, bright orange impact where the axe bites. Strong scale contrast, no gore.
titanbane.utility: One oversized iron chain wrapped tightly around a dark boot and anchored to a heavy rock. Taut diagonal chain, orange highlights.
dreadnought.signature: Three expanding orange concentric shock rings radiating through dark cracked stone around a central iron spike. Top-down seismic motif.
dreadnought.utility: An iron helmet roaring through a thick riveted circular steel barrier, icy arrows break on its rim. Orange glow inside, no full figure.
warmonger.signature: A snarling dark iron war mask projecting three jagged red fear rays toward small fleeing dark silhouettes. Mask dominates, no detailed crowd.
warmonger.utility: A raised iron gauntlet at center twisting three dark arrowheads around it in a disruptive orange spiral. Challenge and redirected foes, no people.
colossus.signature: An enormous iron hammer raised over a tiny glowing cracked world-shaped stone sphere, charged with thick orange energy. Imminent devastating impact.
colossus.utility: A heavy iron breastplate fused into a squat mountain of dark stone, a compact molten orange core glowing behind the armor. Stable triangular silhouette.
sniper.signature: A tightly drawn wooden longbow with one luminous amber arrow aimed diagonally upward, thick green charge spiral gathering at the arrowhead. Close crop on bow and arrow, no archer.
sniper.utility: A large gold eye with a bright green diamond target reflected in its iris, one small cracked armor plate underneath. Exposed weak point, eye dominates.
bowmaster.signature: A single silver arrow piercing three dark shield silhouettes arranged along a clean diagonal line, brilliant green trail connects them. No people.
bowmaster.utility: A large hawk eye above two receding mountain peaks, a narrow gold sight beam reaches the distant peak. Strong eye and distance motif.
deadeye.signature: Extreme closeup of a single broad silver arrowhead entering the exact center of a small gold bullseye with one white starburst. Arrowhead dominates, precise and clean.
deadeye.utility: A dark hooded target head enclosed by four chunky amber sight brackets, bright green beacon directly above it. No archer or weapons.
raincaller.signature: Five large silver arrows descending diagonally through a dark storm cloud, trailing broad green light. Downward arrow rain silhouette.
raincaller.utility: A green storm cloud hovering above a gold circular ground marker, one thick branching gold lightning mark between them. No arrows.
arbalist.signature: A huge square-headed crossbow bolt cracking an iron shield, thick amber impact and green speed trail. The heavy bolt is dominant.
arbalist.utility: A glowing green padlock whose central keyhole is a small amber crosshair, two short pursuit streaks behind. Clear tracking lock emblem, no text.
artillerist.signature: A compact wooden repeating crossbow in three-quarter view firing three parallel bright silver bolts with green trails. Weapon dominates, clean silhouette.
artillerist.utility: An open leather bolt case with three chunky amber-fletched bolts and a vivid green energy gem glowing from inside. No figure.
dragonslayer.signature: A long silver ballista arrow piercing a large dark dragon scale with a crimson heart-shaped glow at the point, green trail. One scale, no entire dragon.
dragonslayer.utility: A massive dragon head silhouette with one bold amber hunting reticle over its eye, dark green scales, gold illuminated horns. Head dominates.
skirmisher.signature: Three arrows fanning wide from a curved wooden bow, swept green motion ribbon across the bottom. Wide fan composition, no archer.
skirmisher.utility: One running leather boot beside an amber eye-shaped hunting mark, flowing green trail links them. Boot dominates, no scenery.
windrunner.signature: A drawn bow angled sideways with two arrows flying in parallel and one broad wind ribbon curling behind it. Pale green and silver, no archer.
windrunner.utility: Two broad pale-green feathers swept forward in a strong curved gust, a small amber energy gem nestled between their bases. Simple airy silhouette.
pathfinder.signature: Two wolf head silhouettes flanking a single arrow aimed toward an amber target, joined by one green chase trail. Broad shapes, no full wolves.
pathfinder.utility: A stout wooden trail marker with a bright green crystal beacon on top, two broad gold path ribbons branch toward it. No writing or runes.
tempest_archer.signature: A single silver arrow curving into a luminous green cyclone loop, three bright amber impact nodes along the arc. Cyclone dominates, no scene.
tempest_archer.utility: A luminous amber eye inside a broad green gust spiral, one small leaf-shaped energy crystal at the bottom. Compact wind-and-sight emblem.
saboteur.signature: A stout crossbow bolt with a black spherical bomb attached behind its broad arrowhead, short burning orange fuse, dark green fletching. No explosion yet.
saboteur.utility: A low green crystal beacon encircled by a thick glowing rope snare, two angular amber detection rays above. Clear planted trap silhouette.
trapper.signature: Two large open iron jaw traps connected by one glowing green ground ring, amber pressure plate at the center. Close trap arrangement.
trapper.utility: A thick coil of thorny dark wire wrapped around a single leather boot, green tension glow and amber thorn tips. Restrained movement, no figure.
demolitionist.signature: One explosive bolt breaking into three large orange firebursts arranged in a triangular spread, green tail at upper left. Chunky distinct blasts.
demolitionist.utility: A bright orange impact star held inside four green targeting brackets over a small dark bomb silhouette. Marked future explosion, no projectile.
priest.signature: Three ivory heart emblems arranged in an upward arc above two praying hands, joined by one flowing gold healing ribbon. Broad hands and hearts, no people.
priest.utility: One ivory hand gently sweeping a dark violet thorn from a glowing gold heart. Cleansing gesture, clean isolated closeup.
hierophant.signature: A large gold chalice overflowing with broad ivory light into three small hearts beneath. Sacred healing abundance, no text or runes.
hierophant.utility: A bright ivory bell with a broad golden sound ring shattering two violet curse shards. Cleanse and silence motif, bell dominates.
saint.signature: A cracked dim red heart being restored by a brilliant ivory star at its center, two gold wings cradle it. Near-death rescue, no figure.
saint.utility: A broad golden halo lies horizontally on consecrated ground, a single white lily grows from its luminous center. Low healing ground motif.
exorcist.signature: A bright gold mace head striking a dark violet curse orb, one thick ivory ribbon curves from the impact into a small warm heart. Damage turned to healing.
exorcist.utility: An open ivory palm projects a broad gold force wedge pushing a dark horned spirit away. Palm dominates, two clear opposing silhouettes.
oracle.signature: A golden hourglass enclosed in an ivory shield, the lower chamber contains a glowing heart and the upper a small crack of violet threat. Protective future healing.
oracle.utility: An open golden eye behind a translucent ivory shield, one dark arrow is softened as it touches the barrier. Eye and shield, no figure.
fateweaver.signature: A shining ivory needle stitches a severed golden life-thread back together above a small restored heart. Thick thread, simple repair gesture.
fateweaver.utility: A large gold eye sees one dark arrow before it reaches an ivory heart, a curved translucent barrier blooms in the arrow path. Side-on prophecy composition.
seraph.signature: Three radiant ivory hearts linked diagonally by thick gold chain links, one sweeping wing behind them. Healing chain, not iron restraint.
seraph.utility: An ivory shield rises on two upswept gold wings with a bright upward trail and one small lavender tether below. Ascending protection.
shaman.signature: A broad turquoise spirit stream flows from an ivory hand into one gold heart, a thick luminous tether anchors both. Current dominates, no scenery.
shaman.utility: A short carved wooden spirit totem with a calm ivory face and gold eyes, radiating two broad turquoise healing rings. Totem fills square.
lifewarden.signature: Two gold hearts joined by a strong green vine with two broad ivory leaves. Living healing bond, no chain or people.
lifewarden.utility: A large green seed suspended within two protective ivory leaves, a translucent golden shield outline waits behind it. Seed at center, delayed protection.
grovekeeper.signature: One enormous ivory-and-gold flower blooming with a luminous green healing core, three broad leaves around base. Bold flower silhouette.
grovekeeper.utility: A thick ring of green thorn branches protects a glowing ivory heart, sharp gold thorns point outward. Defensive thorn wreath.
shepherd.signature: Three golden singing bells arranged around a central ivory heart, broad sound ribbons converge to strengthen its glow. No letters or musical notation.
shepherd.utility: An ivory shepherd crook draws three small golden shield emblems together on one flowing pale-green ribbon. Crook dominates, gathering allies.
spiritcaller.signature: One translucent ivory ancestral hand mirrored by a second lavender spirit hand, both hold matching gold healing lights. Clear echo pair.
spiritcaller.utility: Three ivory soul flames joined by a thick circular gold tether around a shared small shield. Interconnected spirits, no full figures.
mistweaver.signature: A curling turquoise tidal wave with an ivory glowing crest, carrying a gold heart while dissolving a small violet curse shape beneath. Healing tide dominates.
mistweaver.utility: A leather boot stepping through a pale turquoise mist veil, ivory shield shimmer around its toe and broken violet curse ribbon behind. Clean movement silhouette.
soulwarden.signature: A large calm ivory ancestral face emerging above two small gold shielded hearts, lavender spirit ribbons bind them. Guardian spirit dominates.
soulwarden.utility: Two ivory hands cup three gold soul lights within one broad translucent lavender shield, thick golden tethers join the lights. Communion and shared protection.
mage.signature: Three broad cyan arcane bolts flying parallel through two dark target silhouettes, bright violet trails form a clean forward wedge. Pure magic, no arrows.
mage.utility: One luminous cyan spell orb reflected by a second slightly smaller violet orb, connected by a thick curved echo ribbon. Double spell motif, no people.
elementalist.signature: Three large elemental masses collide at center: orange flame, blue ice crystal, violet lightning bolt. Bright white convergence core, no scenery.
elementalist.utility: A dark target silhouette split into three broad colored facets of fire, ice and lightning, enclosed by a vivid cyan eye-shaped marker. Target exposure.
pyromancer.signature: A single towering orange flame pillar rising from a broad burning ground ring, white-hot center and dark violet shadows. Sustained inferno, no fireball.
pyromancer.utility: A bright orange eye-shaped ember mark hovering over one charred armor plate with glowing cracks. Vulnerability to fire, no explosion.
cryomancer.signature: Three broad jagged ice shards swirling inside a white-and-cyan blizzard spiral, deep blue center. Strong cold vortex, minimal snowflakes.
cryomancer.utility: A large faceted cyan ice shield breaking a violet chain around it, white frosted edges. Clean protective slab, no person.
battlemage.signature: A broad crescent-shaped cyan magic cleave sweeps from a steel sword into a small violet shield. Dominant crescent slash, no figure.
battlemage.utility: Three thick violet geometric rune stones form a triangular guard around one cyan shield, one dark arrow deflects off it. No readable letters.
spellblade.signature: A long luminous cyan energy sword angled diagonally, its blade splitting into two close violet speed afterimages. Blade dominates, no person or ground.
spellblade.utility: An armored gauntlet grips a bright blue spell orb while a violet shield flare and short cyan forward streak wrap its wrist. Empowered combat casting.
arcane_knight.signature: A silver sword cleaves a large violet spell orb in two, cyan disruptive shock flash at the cut. Broken spell, no text.
arcane_knight.utility: One large cyan shield radiates two thick violet rings toward two smaller ally shields. Protective outward pulse, no people.
occultist.signature: One long dark violet lance with a sharp magenta point pierces a gray target sigil, trailing thick shadow smoke. Dark piercing magic, no arrow fletching.
occultist.utility: A huge violet occult eye opens in black smoke, its cyan iris casts three broad detection rays downward. Eye dominates, no letters or runes.
necromancer.signature: A newly raised armored skeleton servant emerging from broken earth, skull and upper torso dominate, cyan soul flame in eye sockets and violet summoning glow. This is a summon ability, NOT a damage beam or draining heart.
necromancer.utility: A skeletal hand coated in blue frost grips a dark boot from below, violet ground mist. Grave-born slow and weakness, no full person.
lich.signature: A crowned undead servant skull with two bright cyan soul streams coiling around its shoulders and a violet necromantic aura. Summoned draining servant, no plain projectile.
lich.utility: A heavy ornate violet phylactery vessel enclosing a bright cyan soul flame, a dark fatal arrow breaks against its shell. Vessel dominates, no skull or text.
plaguebringer.signature: A hooded undead servant head and shoulders emerging through sickly green rot, one bony hand raised, violet summoning light behind. Clear summoned undead, no poison potion.
plaguebringer.utility: A thick green miasma cloud curls around a violet skull-shaped void, a dark boot at bottom sinks into the fog. Toxic slow field, broad cloud.
summoner.signature: A spectral wolf head and shoulders emerge from a violet summoning ring, luminous cyan fur edges and calm protective posture. Animal servant dominates.
summoner.utility: A broad violet geometric seal beneath one cyan shield and two small bright ally stars, thick upward magical light. Command and protection, no readable runes.
demonologist.signature: A fiery horned Nether servant head emerges through a tall violet portal, molten orange eyes and cyan-edged portal rim. Summon dominates, no entire landscape.
demonologist.utility: A dark clawed hand seals a glowing violet pact orb, orange power pours into a cracked cyan shield beneath. Power with defensive cost, no text.
spiritbinder.signature: A small pale-cyan winged Vex-like spirit holding an iron sword hovers before a violet protective halo. Large head, compact body, four clear wings, summoned guardian.
spiritbinder.utility: Three bright cyan soul crystals connected by thick violet tethers inside one shared translucent shield. Shared essence and divided harm, no people.
